Client Agreement

Terms of Service

Last Updated: October 2026  |  Ellora Spaces

Welcome to Ellora Spaces. We provide premium architectural surfaces, designer tiles, and bespoke artisanal wallpapers for residential and commercial environments. By accessing our website, purchasing swatches, or commissioning an order through our digital boutique or trade concierge, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

1. General Conditions

This website is operated by Ellora Spaces. Throughout the site, the terms “we”, “us”, and “our” refer to Ellora Spaces. We reserve the right to refuse service, limit order quantities, or cancel orders at our sole discretion where inventory discrepancies or pricing errors occur.

By agreeing to these Terms of Service, you represent that you are of legal age in your jurisdiction to enter into binding purchase contracts.

2. Material Characteristics, Natural Variation & Dye Lots

Our collections celebrate authentic materiality, organic stones, ceramic artistry, and artisanal wallpapers. Because of the handcrafted and natural composition of our catalog, you acknowledge that:

  • Natural Variation: Marble, limestone, terracotta, and handcrafted ceramic glazes possess inherent variations in veining, pitting, undertones, and texture. These are hallmarks of natural authenticity and are not defects.
  • Dye Lots & Production Runs: Wallpapers and fired tiles are manufactured in batches. Subtle tonal shifts can occur between different production runs. We strongly advise ordering all required square footage (including an industry-standard 10–15% overage for cuts and attic stock) in a single order.
  • Digital Imagery & Sample Swatches: Screen displays and calibrations differ across devices. We strongly recommend ordering physical material sample swatches before committing to full-scale orders.

3. Pricing, Invoicing & Trade Accounts

All prices listed on our boutique are displayed in the store's currency and are subject to change without prior notice. Applicable taxes and specialized freight shipping costs are calculated at checkout.

  • Trade Accounts: Licensed architects, interior designers, and commercial contractors qualifying for trade pricing receive formal custom quotes. Quotes remain valid for 30 calendar days from issuance.
  • Payment Terms: Full payment is required before freight dispatch or initiating custom wallpaper print runs.

4. Freight Delivery, Site Readiness & Receiving

Because tile and wallpaper shipments represent substantial weight and fragile cargo, specific receiving terms apply:

  • Curbside Pallet Freight: Full tile orders are shipped on secure wooden pallets via liftgate freight carriers. Delivery is curbside or loading dock only; drivers cannot carry materials inside buildings or upper floors.
  • Inspection on Arrival: The recipient must thoroughly inspect the shipment upon arrival before signing the Bill of Lading (BOL). Any visible box or pallet damage must be noted directly on the delivery receipt and photographed within 48 hours.
  • Storage: Wallpapers and tiles must be kept in dry, climate-controlled indoor environments prior to installation.

5. Installation Policy

Important Industry Rule: Installation constitutes acceptance of the material. Ellora Spaces accepts no returns, exchanges, or financial claims once tiles have been cut or installed in mortar, or wallpaper has been pasted to walls.

Clients and professional installers must inspect all tiles and paper rolls prior to beginning work. Please ensure your contractor follows substrate preparation guidelines, appropriate adhesives, grout spacing, and sealants suitable for the space.

6. Returns & Cancellations

  • Sample Swatches: Material sample boxes and individual swatches are final sale and non-refundable.
  • Custom & Made-to-Order: Artisanal wallpapers printed to custom wall dimensions and bespoke architectural cuts cannot be returned or cancelled once production has started.
  • Stock Items: Unopened, full boxes of standard in-stock tiles may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery, subject to a 20% restocking fee and client-arranged return freight. Partial boxes cannot be accepted.

7. Intellectual Property

All photography, product surface patterns, brand trademarks, and editorial essays published by Ellora Spaces remain our exclusive intellectual property and may not be reproduced without written consent.

8. Governing Law

These Terms of Service are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, and any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts therein.
